        res.XCL_075 AS driver_id,

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        d.XCL_034 AS driver_id,
        d.XCL_038 AS driver_name,
        d.XCL_039 AS surname,
        d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
        d.XCL_040 AS birth_date,
        r.XCL_069 AS race_name,
        res.XCL_088 AS lap_time,
        (CAST(SUBSTR(res.XCL_088,1,INSTR(res.XCL_088,':')-1) AS REAL)*60
         + CAST(SUBSTR(res.XCL_088,INSTR(res.XCL_088,':')+1) AS REAL)) AS secs
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
    JOIN races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
    JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'
      AND c.XCL_005 = 'Italy'
      AND res.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
),
youngest AS (
    SELECT driver_id
    FROM qualifying
    ORDER BY birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    q.driver_name,
    q.nationality,
    q.lap_time,
    q.race_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN youngest y ON q.driver_id = y.driver_id
ORDER BY q.secs ASC
LIMIT 1
